metadata.description: Occupational questionnaire on job demands, decision latitude, and social support.
metadata.intended_use: Work-stress research, occupational health, and psychosocial workplace assessment.
metadata.development_history: Developed from the demand-control-support model for internationally comparable occupational research.
metadata.measurement_rationale: High demands combined with low control and low support represent a psychosocial work-stress risk pattern.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Use the exact German form and scoring syntax; JCQ dimensions describe work characteristics and do not diagnose individual burnout.

versions.source_citation: Karasek et al. (1998). The Job Content Questionnaire (JCQ): an instrument for internationally comparative assessments of psychosocial job characteristics.
